text: {"answer":"For HTTPS URLs with verify enabled, requests sets conn.cert_reqs to \"CERT_REQUIRED\". If verify is a path, it checks that the path exists and uses it as either conn.ca_certs (file) or conn.ca_cert_dir (directory). If verification is disabled or the URL is not HTTPS, it sets conn.cert_reqs to \"CERT_NONE\" and clears the CA settings. A provided client certificate is configured as cert_file, with an optional key_file, and both paths are validated.","file":"adapters.py","line":316}
